notes: The supplied text does not contain the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement requirements. 'Cal-GETC' appears only as a row in the Program Completion table (page 222); section_heading records that row name.

Page 221 prints the 'LACCD GENERAL EDUCATION PLAN 2026-2027' (local GE for associate degrees, minimum 27 semester units), which explicitly may NOT be used for ADTs and is not the Cal-GETC pattern; its courses were not recorded as blocks for this award.
The Area 5 Natural Sciences list on page 221 appears cut off (no lab area shown), which may explain why ANTHRO 111, ASTRON 5, EARTH 2, GEOG 15 and PHYS SC 14 are absent.
No total units, outcomes or careers are printed for the Cal-GETC certificate in this text. A reviewer should locate the actual Cal-GETC certificate pages (likely elsewhere in the catalog).
